purpose: Reusable technique diagram library for recipe pages. Copy the needed SVGs into the artifact's img/ dir and reference them at the step where the technique first appears. Hand-authored line art, drawn to real culinary dimensions (1 in = 120px in cut-sizes.svg). Style: cream #faf7f0 background, ink #2b2a26, accent #b5563a, Georgia labels. New diagrams must match.

diagrams.shows: 4 panels: halve through root and peel, lengthwise cuts stopping at root, crosswise slicing, 1/4in result size
3 panels: smash under flat blade to peel, slice thin, rock-chop to 1/16in
to-scale size chart of the five cut words against a 1-inch bar
3 panels: open out and trim the fat flap, spot the fibres running end to end, cut across them into 3/4in strips shown to scale
